An unforgettable evening of music, light, and magic under the stars

Dawn — 6:00 AM

Dawn Jazz

Start your evening with smooth jazz melodies as the sky transitions from twilight to starlight. Our resident jazz ensemble will perform timeless classics and contemporary favorites in an intimate outdoor setting.

Free Admission
Midnight — 11:30 PM

River Lantern Walk

Join us for a serene walk along the riverbanks, illuminated by thousands of floating lanterns. Each lantern represents a wish, creating a breathtaking spectacle of light and reflection. Guided by soft ambient music and guided by our event marshals.

$25 per person

Night — 2:00 AM

Midnight Sold-Out Concert

The headlining performance of the night featuring an electrifying live concert with world-class artists performing in the heart of the garden. Due to overwhelming demand, this exclusive event has sold out. Thank you to everyone who purchased tickets - we truly appreciate your support!

$75 per person
